content_zh: 丽江古城中，一场足球赛发生在当地少数民族与外来背包客之间。作为一座被建构起来的旅游城市，丽江承载了无数原始、圣洁、神秘、和平和充满异域色彩的“香格里拉想象”，但在这座雪山下的足球场上，有什么东西似乎在本地人与外来者之间的奔跑、冲撞、喘息与汗水中开始融化。
content_en: A football game between local ethnic group and visiting backpackers was programmed in the old town of Lijiang. As a tourist destinition, Lijiang embodies countless imagination of primal purity, sacred mystery, tranquil peace and exotic allure the very essence of the 'Shangri-La Fantasy'. However, on the football pitch beneath the snow-capped mountains, something seems to be melting away amidst the sprinting, collisions, gasps and sweat between the locals and outsiders.
